motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to approve the Consent Agenda. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Consent agenda approved
motions.summary: The council cleared its consent agenda, the batch of items handled together without separate discussion.
motions.impact: Consent items are the ones the council judged uncontroversial enough to pass in a single vote. The motion itself lists no specifics, so there is nothing here for a resident to act on.

motions.item_title: A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving and Authorizing the Execution of an Interlocal Cooperation Agreement for Participation in the Utah Valley HOME Consortium
motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to adopt a Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving and Authorizing the Execution of an Interlocal Cooperation Agreement for Participation in the Utah Valley HOME Consortium. Councilmember Burnham seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Join Utah Valley housing grant group
motions.summary: Eagle Mountain signed on to the Utah Valley HOME Consortium, an agreement with other Utah County governments to take part in federal housing money.
motions.impact: Joining the consortium is an agreement between governments, not a program with an address or a price tag attached. Nothing on your street changes because of this vote.
